data.name: label2.Text
data.value:
How to connect a PS4 controller to PC:
1. USB Cable: - Plug the controller into your PC. - Windows should recognize it automatically.
2. Bluetooth: - Hold "PS" + "Share" until the light flashes. - On PC, go to Settings > Bluetooth > Add Device > Wireless Controller.
3. Optional: - Use DS4Windows to remap buttons, change light colors, and play games that only support Xbox controllers.
